description_excerpt: Job Description WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON What you will focus on Support the Audio Team in creating, editing, implementing, and managing audio assets for games, including sound effects and voice-over recordings. The internship provides hands-on experience in game audio production, audio asset management, and opportunities to explore AI-assisted tools and workflows.
